name: Volume Texture Ping-Pong Swap
definition: Manages dynamic 3D scalar fields in GPU memory using a double-buffered ping-pong swap to avoid full re-uploads on field updates.
summary: Volume Texture Ping-Pong Swap manages dynamic 3D scalar fields in GPU memory using double-buffered updates to avoid full re-uploads, differing from atlas updates by operating on single 3D textures.
